inputs.text: [excited] Kozz… moh… SERR… uh… tops. [curious] Three Greek words: "kosmos," decorated, like a fancy costume. "Cerat" is horn. [whispers] And "ops" is face.
[curious] So it's the decorated horned face?

[happily] Exactly. [warmly] He lived in Utah, in North America, seventy-six million years ago. [curious] His second name, "richardsoni," honors Scott Richardson, a volunteer who found his skull in the desert.
